kultivator.guide.chapter.20.desc: A harbour on the coast, an oasis in the desert, a canal water town, a terraced mountain town and the Demon City in the dark lands: each with its own trade, characters and story chain.
kultivator.guide.c20.pelabuhan.title: Enter a Harbour Town
kultivator.guide.c20.pelabuhan.body:
The Harbour Town stands on the coast, a third of it over the sea on piles. Matting-sailed merchant ships arrive in the morning of their cycle, drop anchor and are unloaded by porters.
The lighthouse at the end of the breakwater guides ships home. The Morning Fish Market sells a filling fish soup.
kultivator.guide.c20.oasis.title: Enter a Desert Oasis
kultivator.guide.c20.oasis.body:
In desert or badlands, look for mud-brick walls around a crescent lake. The Jade Gate inspects your trade goods: a Desert Pass waives the duty.
Sandstorms come every few days; inside the walls you are safe, outside without the Spring Blessing your steps slow.
kultivator.guide.c20.air.title: Enter a Water Town
kultivator.guide.c20.air.body:
The Water Town grows on low flat land near water: joined canals, arched bridges, white walls with black tiles. The Post Boat carries you between stops.
House Su's Silk House and the Tea Pavilion are the heart of its trade.
kultivator.guide.c20.gunung.title: Enter a Mountain Town
kultivator.guide.c20.gunung.body:
The Mountain Town climbs three rows of terraces up a slope, from the foot gate to the Golden Summit. Cable cars and pulleys carry people and goods; porters carry for those who walk.
Beware of rockfalls in the rain, and do not hold a bun near the monkeys.
kultivator.guide.c20.dagang.title: Trade between towns
kultivator.guide.c20.dagang.body:
Each themed town makes its own trade goods: buy at the home town (16 units of each good a day), sell in another town that values them higher. The Trade Ledger (/kultivasi dagang) keeps the last prices you saw.
A market flooded with the same good gets saturated, and weekly profit is capped by your realm. Sell one good at a profit to tick this step.
kultivator.guide.c20.laut.title: Cross the sea
kultivator.guide.c20.laut.body:
In the Harbour Town, the Sea-Crossing Ship sails once a day to the Boundless Sea for cultivators of Foundation and above. Two of your disciples may come.
The Homeward Gate there brings you back to the harbour pier.
kultivator.guide.c20.ziarah.title: The Thousand Steps
kultivator.guide.c20.ziarah.body:
Pilgrimage Season in the Mountain Town: climb the nine smoking landings from the foot gate to the Golden Hall, bowing at each, without flying.
The Summit Blessing makes meditation on the Golden Hall terrace far stronger.
kultivator.guide.c20.lentera.title: Night of Water Lanterns
kultivator.guide.c20.lentera.body: On the night of the new moon, the Water Town's people float lotus lanterns on the canals so that lost souls can find their way home. Buy a lantern and write your wish; only you can read it.
kultivator.guide.c20.iblis.title: The Demon City (optional)
kultivator.guide.c20.iblis.body:
The Demon City only admits Golden Core cultivators and above and takes a toll at the Skull Gate. Only the Pact Zone, the black market and the poison tavern, is safe; beyond it, at night, hunters demand a road toll.
Entering it is not required of the righteous.
kultivator.guide.c20.tebus.title: Ransom a captive (optional)
kultivator.guide.c20.tebus.body: At the Demon City's Captive Pens no one is sold: captives can only be ransomed and escorted home to their village. That village will remember your kindness.
